mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen monotonically from -21.4% to -17.7% over four weeks, signaling sustained recovery momentum. This trend will continue linearly over the next four weeks, producing higher mean RETAIL_REC than the prior four-week baseline.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 3.7 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is equal to or lower than the mean over the prior 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has improved from -21.6% to -9.6% (12 point gain), indicating return-to-office behavior. This workplace resumption triggers compensatory retail and recreation visits during commute windows and after-work hours, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises more than 10 percentage points over four weeks
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved 12 points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase relative to its four-week mean within two weeks of the decision point, or WORKPLACES reverses by more than 5 points.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT station usage has improved from -20.7% to -14.0% (6.7 point gain), indicating increased commuting and mobility infrastructure use. Rising transit use co-occurs with retail recovery because transit-dependent populations access retail districts; the two series move together with a one-week lag.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises more than 5 percentage points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 6.7 points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to increase in the week following a week in which TRANSIT rises more than 5 points, in more than two consecutive instances.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has remained elevated (22.4–27.0%), indicating sustained essential-goods demand. If GROCERY_PHARM stays above 25%, it signals low restriction severity, permitting retail-and-recreation venues to operate with fewer capacity constraints. This regime enables RETAIL_REC recovery over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM falls below 20% and RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC declines despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining above 25%.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has declined from 10.9% to 7.3%, indicating people are spending less time at home. This outflow from residential spaces is reallocated to retail and recreation venues. The decline in RESIDENTIAL over the past four weeks predicts continued outflow and higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined 3.6 points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL rebounds above 9% and RETAIL_REC does not increase, or RETAIL_REC declines despite RESIDENTIAL remaining below 8%.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has declined from -14.9% to -17.1% (worsening), indicating seasonal weather constraints or reduced outdoor activity preference. As outdoor recreation becomes less attractive, consumers substitute toward indoor retail and recreation venues, driving RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: PARKS rebounds above -10% and RETAIL_REC does not increase, or RETAIL_REC declines despite PARKS remaining below -15%.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both show sustained improvement (12 and 6.7 point gains respectively), indicating coordinated return to commuting infrastructure. This dual signal of workplace and transit recovery creates a multiplier effect: commuters access retail during transit and work-adjacent hours. The interaction of both rising proxies predicts RETAIL_REC acceleration over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT rise more than 5 points week-on-week simultaneously
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both improved over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within two weeks when both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT rise simultaneously, or either proxy reverses by more than 3 points.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM elevation (27.0%) combined with WORKPLACES recovery (-9.6%) signals a regime where essential services and workplace activity are both normalized. Under this dual-normalization regime, retail-and-recreation venues operate with minimal restrictions and attract commuters and essential-goods shoppers. RETAIL_REC will rise over the next four weeks only if both conditions persist.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM above 25 AND WORKPLACES above -15 percentage points
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM at 27.0% and WORKPLACES at -9.6% in t-0w
failure_condition: Either GROCERY_PHARM falls below 20% or WORKPLACES falls below -15%, and RETAIL_REC does not increase; or both conditions hold and RETAIL_REC declines.
